name: @w6w-apps/phrase
description: Manage Phrase Strings localization projects: locales, keys, translations, file uploads and downloads, and jobs.

w6w.longDescription:
Phrase Strings is a localization platform for software: developers push source strings in, translators and machine translation fill in every language, and the finished files flow back into the build. This app puts that loop inside a workflow.

It covers the day-to-day surface of the Strings API: projects and their locales, translation keys (create, tag, search, update, delete), translations (set, edit, verify), file uploads in any of Phrase's formats with a pollable processing state, locale downloads in any export format, and translation jobs that route keys to translators.

Both Phrase data centres are supported: pick EU or US on the connection and every call goes to the right host. List actions return a uniform page object with the total and the next page number so a workflow can walk a large project safely. Health checks follow Phrase's own status page for the connection's data centre and the live rate-limit window.
